description: Runs a small or mid-sized business, wears multiple hats, and is looking for practical ways to grow revenue without hiring a big team.
demographics: Age 28-45, owns or co-owns a business with 1-20 employees, active on Facebook and YouTube, moderate technical skill.
pain_points: Not enough time to create consistent content
Unsure which marketing channel actually drives sales
Overwhelmed by too many tools and too much conflicting advice
goals: Generate more qualified leads without increasing ad spend
Build an audience that trusts the brand
Turn existing knowledge/content into reusable marketing assets
tone_of_voice: Direct, encouraging, and practical — speaks like a knowledgeable peer, not a corporate brand. Avoids jargon.
preferred_cta: Invite the reader to take one small, specific next step (comment a keyword, download a resource, or book a call) rather than a generic 'learn more'.
